# Pull request

## Problem and behavior

Describe the trigger and resulting behavior. Link the task and applicable design decision.

## Validation

Record commands, results, and limits. Include the normal developer entry point and relevant failure cases.

## Review considerations

- Tenant, app, and authorization boundaries; secrets and log safety.
- Compatibility, configuration, and documentation changes.
- Migrations, rollout, recovery, and observability where applicable.
- Observed behavior, test evidence, and assumptions kept distinct.
